spots.text: Everything that falls here arrives. Nothing that arrives here leaves. The water does not mind.

meta.label: The Waterfall Stair
meta.blurb: Somebody left a tap running on the upper floor, a long time ago. The stair has made its peace with it; so has the moss.

secrets.name: The Grotto Behind the Fall
secrets.text: You walked through the waterfall. Behind it the roar goes soft, somebody has left a candle burning, and the book on the stone is dry.
